## alibaba_oss

Connector: `asterdrive.storage.alibaba_oss`; owner: AsterDrive storage maintainers; fallback: repository maintainers; API: OSS REST; OSS4-HMAC-SHA256; connector config V1.

SDK/transport: `aws-sdk-s3@1.157.0`, `reqwest@0.13.5`.

Code: [src/storage/connectors/alibaba_oss.rs](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/blob/master/src/storage/connectors/alibaba_oss.rs), [src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/mod.rs](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/blob/master/src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/mod.rs).

Fixtures: [src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/tests.rs](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/blob/master/src/storage/drivers/alibaba_oss/tests.rs).

Cloud acceptance: **not_recorded** — No cloud acceptance record is asserted by this index; local fixtures and historical PR claims are separate evidence.

| 能力 | 结论与边界 | 官方依据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-objects"></a>对象读写 | 对象操作复用 S3 serializer，鉴权改为 OSS V4；不能把 AWS 协议当成 OSS 依据。 | [api](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/putobject), [v4](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/recommend-to-use-signature-version-4) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-uploads"></a>分片/续传 | 独立验证 initiate/part/list/complete/abort 及非末片限制。 | [multipart](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/initiatemultipartupload) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-signing"></a>签名/预签名 | 普通请求与 presigned 都覆盖最终 host/编码 key；公网与服务端 endpoint 分开。 | [v4](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/recommend-to-use-signature-version-4), [presign](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/add-signatures-to-urls) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-cors"></a>CORS | GetBucketCors/PutBucketCors 整体读合并写；20 条/16 KiB，保留 ResponseVary 与顺序，拒绝遮蔽。 | [getcors](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/getbucketcors), [putcors](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/putbucketcors) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-range_etag"></a>Range/ETag | Range、ETag 与条件请求依据 GetObject；ETag 不等同内容哈希承诺。 | [get](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/getobject) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-errors"></a>错误 | 按 status/code/request ID 脱敏映射，403 不能解释为对象不存在。 | [errors](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/getobject) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-permissions"></a>权限 | 对象权限与 oss:GetBucketCors/oss:PutBucketCors 管理权限分开。 | [api](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/putobject), [getcors](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/getbucketcors), [putcors](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/putbucketcors) |
| <a id="alibaba_oss-domains"></a>源站/上传/CDN/自定义域 | CNAME 是源站 API 别名；CDN Type A 是独立下载鉴权，上传与 CDN 另验。 | [cname](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/map-custom-domain-names-5), [cdn](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cdn/user-guide/type-a-signing) |

Connector: `asterdrive.storage.sftp`; owner: AsterDrive storage maintainers; fallback: repository maintainers; API: SSH transport RFC 4253; SFTP v3 draft; connector config V1.

| 能力 | 结论与边界 | 官方依据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="sftp-objects"></a>对象读写 | SSH 上的 SFTP v3 文件操作；host key 校验独立于用户密码。 | [ssh](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4253), [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
| <a id="sftp-uploads"></a>分片/续传 | 服务端流式读写，不声明浏览器 multipart/resumable 能力。 | [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
| <a id="sftp-signing"></a>签名/预签名 | 无 HTTP presigned；SSH 握手、主机指纹和凭据由连接器配置。 | [ssh](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4253) |
| <a id="sftp-cors"></a>CORS | 非 HTTP 协议，无 provider CORS；浏览器访问由 Drive 中继。 | [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
| <a id="sftp-range_etag"></a>Range/ETag | 偏移读取不等同 HTTP Range/ETag；HTTP 层合同由 Drive 提供。 | [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
| <a id="sftp-errors"></a>错误 | SSH 连接失败与 SFTP status code 分别映射，权限拒绝不能视为文件不存在。 | [ssh](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4253), [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
| <a id="sftp-permissions"></a>权限 | 账号和远端文件系统权限，不能套用 bucket/IAM 权限名。 | [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
| <a id="sftp-domains"></a>源站/上传/CDN/自定义域 | sftp endpoint 与 base_path；没有源站/CDN/custom-domain 的 HTTP 能力声明。 | [ssh](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4253), [sftp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-secsh-filexfer-02) |
